title: Knowledge bases
subtitle: Private, searchable source material for your workspace.
name: Name
empty_hint: Create a source library, then add files or URLs for search and answers.
supported_formats: MD, TXT, HTML, CSV, DOCX, XLSX, PDF
ask_placeholder: Ask a question about these sources
insufficient: There is not enough evidence to answer this reliably.
graph_hint: Explore current-evidence entities and relations. Depth is bounded to two hops.
truncated: The graph is limited to the safe result size.
no_graph: No graph data is available yet.
workspace_model_description: Workspace administrators manage the provider connection and the default model used for extraction and answers.
admin_only: Only workspace owners and admins can change provider connections or the default model.
main_model_hint: Test a fixed JSON response before saving. The model list is optional; you can always enter a model ID manually.
base_url_hint: Use an absolute HTTPS URL with the API version prefix, for example /v1.
api_key_hint: Stored encrypted and never returned to the browser.
api_key_required: Enter an API key before testing a new provider.
base_url_required: Enter a Base URL for the custom provider.
model_hint: Choose from discovered models or enter the provider's model ID.
model_required: Enter a main model before saving.
save_failed: Could not save the knowledge model settings.
provider_test_failed: The text/JSON capability test did not pass.
parse_enhancement_hint: Optional model enhancement after basic parsing. Vision mode sends rendered PDF pages to the tested vision-capable model.
vision_test_failed: The vision capability test did not pass.
embedding_hint: Optional. Known presets suggest one candidate; a failed probe keeps keyword search available without replacing the main model.
embedding_provider_required: Choose an enabled provider for the embedding model.
embedding_not_ready: The main model was saved, but semantic search is still waiting for a successful embedding probe.
provider_management_hint: Keys are write-only. Disable a connection before replacing it; referenced connections cannot be deleted.
new_provider_hint: Create another provider from the form above.
preview_unavailable: This source type cannot be previewed inline.
select_block_to_confirm: Select model-derived blocks you have reviewed, then create a new version.
search_controls_hint: These controls apply to this search. The response keeps the effective mode and rerank state.
